title: Fix Add to Cart error and implement drag-and-drop product reordering with marketplace display order persistence

requirements.summary: Fix Add to Cart functionality error in ProductCard component where clicking 'Add to Basket' button fails with error message
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Add to Basket' on ProductCard successfully adds the item to the shopping cart without error messages
Success toast notification displays when item is added to cart
Cart icon badge updates to reflect the new item count
Backend addToCart method is called with correct product ID and user principal
Error handling displays user-friendly error messages if the operation fails

file_operations.description: Review and fix the useAddToCart mutation hook implementation. Verify it calls the correct backend method (addCartItem) with proper parameters (productId as bigint, quantity as bigint). Ensure the mutation invalidates the cart queries on success and displays appropriate toast notifications for success and error states. Check that the hook handles both authenticated and guest user scenarios correctly.

Review the 'Add to Basket' button click handler implementation. Ensure it calls the useAddToCart mutation with the correct product ID (converted to bigint if needed) and quantity value. Verify error handling displays user-friendly messages and that the component responds appropriately to loading states. Ensure the button is properly wired to trigger the mutation.

requirements.summary: Create React Query mutation hook useUpdateProductDisplayOrder that calls backend updateProductDisplayOrder with ordered array of product IDs
acceptanceCriteria: useUpdateProductDisplayOrder mutation hook is available in useQueries.ts
Hook accepts an array of product IDs representing the new order
Successful mutation invalidates product list queries to refresh the display
Hook includes proper error handling and loading states
Toast notification displays success or error messages

file_operations.description: Add a new mutation hook useUpdateProductDisplayOrder that accepts an array of product IDs (as bigint[]) and calls actor.updateProductDisplayOrder. The mutation should invalidate 'products', 'featuredProducts', 'bestSellingProducts', 'mostViewedProducts', and 'newestProducts' query keys on success to refresh the product displays. Include onSuccess toast notification for successful reordering and onError toast for failures. Return the mutation with proper TypeScript typing.

requirements.summary: Install and configure drag-and-drop library to enable drag-and-drop functionality for product rows in ProductManagementTable
acceptanceCriteria: Drag-and-drop library is installed as a frontend dependency
Library is properly imported and initialized in the ProductManagementTable component
Drag-and-drop functionality works smoothly on desktop browsers
Visual feedback indicates when an item is being dragged
Drop zones are clearly indicated during drag operations

file_operations.description: Add @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable as dependencies with compatible versions (e.g., ^6.0.0 or latest stable). These libraries provide the drag-and-drop infrastructure needed for the ProductManagementTable component.

requirements.summary: Add drag-and-drop functionality to ProductManagementTable allowing admin users to reorder products by dragging rows, enabled only when 'All' shape filter is active
acceptanceCriteria: Each product row in ProductManagementTable has a drag handle or is fully draggable
Drag-and-drop is enabled only when 'All' shape filter is selected
Drag-and-drop is disabled when any specific shape filter is active
Visual indicator shows that drag-and-drop is disabled when filters are applied
Dragging a row displays visual feedback showing the drag operation
Dropping a row at a new position immediately updates the table display
After dropping, useUpdateProductDisplayOrder mutation is called with the new order
Table displays products in the new order after successful backend update
Error messages display if the reorder operation fails

file_operations.description: Integrate @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable into the ProductManagementTable component. Wrap the table body with DndContext and SortableContext. Make each product row a SortableItem with a drag handle icon (e.g., grip-vertical icon from lucide-react). Enable drag-and-drop only when selectedShape is 'All' or empty. When a drag operation ends (onDragEnd), update the local product array order and call the useUpdateProductDisplayOrder mutation with the reordered array of product IDs (as bigint[]). Display visual feedback during dragging (e.g., opacity change, cursor change). Show disabled state styling for drag handles when filters are active. Ensure drag-and-drop does not interfere with existing checkbox selection or inline editing features.

requirements.summary: Add visual indicators to ProductManagementTable showing when drag-and-drop reordering is available versus disabled due to active shape filters
acceptanceCriteria: Visual indicator shows drag-and-drop is available when 'All' filter is active
Visual indicator shows drag-and-drop is disabled when shape filters are applied
Tooltip or help text explains the drag-and-drop availability conditions
Drag handles are visually distinct when enabled versus disabled
User understands why drag-and-drop is unavailable when filters are active

file_operations.description: Add visual indicators to communicate drag-and-drop availability. When selectedShape is not 'All', display drag handles with disabled styling (e.g., opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed) and add a tooltip explaining 'Drag-and-drop reordering is only available when viewing all products without filters'. When selectedShape is 'All', show drag handles with active styling (e.g., cursor-grab, hover:bg-gray-100) and a tooltip saying 'Drag to reorder products'. Consider adding an info banner or alert above the table when filters are active stating 'Product reordering is disabled when filters are applied. Select All to enable drag-and-drop reordering.'
